title: Metal found near the Serpent Mound, area of activity

tellings.quote: because where this metal was found was near the Indian serpent mound,

plain: A piece of strange metal is said to have been found near the Serpent Mound in Ohio, an ancient Native American earthwork built in the shape of a snake, which is described as a place of unusual activity. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs and who has been studied by NASA scientists, tells it as something passed to him by a man named Timothy Taylor. Bledsoe brings it up because the spot near the mound would link the metal to a known hot spot of strange events.
